places: junction of the Orange and Makhaleng Rivers

fields.climate: temperate; cool to cold, dry winters; hot, wet summers
fields.terrain: mostly highland with plateaus, hills, and mountains
fields.resources: water, agricultural and grazing land, diamonds, sand, clay, building stone
fields.farm: milk, potatoes, maize, vegetables, fruits, sorghum, wheat, game meat, beans, wool
fields.exports: diamonds, garments, wool, power equipment, bedding
fields.industries: food, beverages, textiles, apparel assembly, handicrafts, construction, tourism
fields.religions: Protestant 47.8% (Pentecostal 23.1%, Lesotho Evangelical 17.3%, Anglican 7.4%), Roman Catholic 39.3%, other Christian 9.1%, non-Christian 1.4%, none 2.3%
fields.legal: mixed system of English common law and Roman-Dutch law; High Court and Court of Appeal review legislative acts
fields.military: 20-30 years of age for voluntary military service for both men and women
